content.content:
Order service API

All responses are JSON unless noted. Requests are made to the address this service is running on.

GET /docs
    This page (plain text).

GET /value
    Returns {"value": <integer>}. No authentication.

POST /token
    Returns {"token": "<token>"}. No authentication. Send the token on authenticated
    requests in the header "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

GET /orders?page=N
    Authenticated. Lists orders, 50 per page; N starts at 1.
    Returns {"page", "total_pages", "items", "next"}. "next" is the path of the following
    page, or null on the last page.
    Each order has: id, customer_id, status, placed_at, amount_cents.
    status is one of: placed, shipped, cancelled, returned.
    placed_at is an ISO 8601 timestamp. amount_cents is an integer number of cents.

GET /customers/{id}
    Authenticated. Returns {"id", "name", "region", "tier", "discount_pct"}; 404 if the id is unknown.
    region is one of: north, south, east, west. discount_pct is a whole-number percentage.

content.text:
I've written `result.json` to the workspace root.

- **Total:** 9,329,707 cents
- **Qualifying orders:** 407 distinct shipped orders placed from 1 March to 31 May 2025 (UTC)
- **Duplicate listings discarded:** 20
- **By region:** north 2,666,579 · south 2,714,624 · east 1,671,579 · west 2,276,925 (these add up to the total)

**Checks against your list:**
- I fetched all 30 pages by following each page's link to the next until there wasn't one.
- Requests that came back with an expired token were retried with a fresh token. Requests that were rate limited were retried after waiting the time the service asked for. No request was skipped.
- Only status exactly "shipped" was counted.
- Each timestamp was converted to UTC before the date check. The range runs up to, but not including, 1 June 00:00 UTC.
- Each order's discount was applied and rounded half up to a whole cent before summing.
- Each customer was looked up once and the result reused.

**About the data:** nothing odd turned up beyond the duplicates you mentioned. Each repeated listing was identical to the first copy. Every timestamp had a timezone, every customer id resolved to a customer record, and the only statuses were the four in the documentation.

The working script is in `/tmp/work`, outside the workspace.
